detail.longDescription: 🦦 NEW: # Yosemite National Park rangers are asking visitors to report sightings, photos, and videos of North American river # otters roaming the park’s 1,700 mi (~2,700 km) of # streams . Because individual otters travel up to 10 mi (16 km) daily and eat 20% of their body weight, public observations help biologists track their # habitat use and recovery. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/environment/help-yo semite-track-river-otters/ # california # wildlife # conservation # nature # biology # animals # science # rivers # mammals # ecology # parks # outdoors # research
